items.q: Jay, my idol on the trombone, and, since I’ve been an adult, one of my very closest friends and confidants

ctx.x: J. J. Johnson: the boss. Jay, my idol on the trombone, and, since I’ve been an adult, one of my very closest friends and confidants, and somebody that I think is one of the original voices in the music, one of the survivors. There are only maybe five or six of the bebop pioneers left: J. J., [James] Moody, Ray Brown, Max Roach. I’m hard pressed to figure out who else. But J. J.: survivor, innovator, mentor, and friend.
